claims.text: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (125B/6B + 51B host n-gram): Tab.11 shows Base beating Qwen3.8-27B-Base on all 14 benchmarks and Qwen3.7-Plus-Base on 8/14 (rest within 2.6 pts) at ~1/3 active params, ~1/3 tokens, ~1/9 FLOPs.
claims.context: Body-consumed Tab.11 context; self-comparison scope retained.

claims.text: Every candidate change evaluated on three axes (loss+benchmarks; training/prefill/decode cost; hyperparameter/stability effects); Gated Residual (4-branch + elementwise gate); n-gram placement/vocab-allocation sections; Muon sections (which params, fused splitting); batch-warmup-unnecessary + stress-test verification.
Loss and downstream accuracy diverge (n-gram vocab lowers loss monotonically, accuracy saturates) — the joint-design thesis.
